table1data.name: Fräsh Berries
table1data.desc:
Berries that refresh the soul along with your hunger and thirst.
These berries are located from the region of Gilead, often in rocky and mountainous locations

table1data.name: Oh Bomb Ahh
table1data.desc: A legendary bomb that clears away any debuff splash effects

table1data.name: Apollonia's boots
table1data.desc: Grants control over solar energy arrows and movement speed increase

table1data.name: Thunderblades
table1data.desc: Charged with electrical power (doubles if a thunderstorm is happening)

table1data.name: Thesius' Club
table1data.desc: When equiped, grants the the user enhanced durability and underwater breathing. Gains power every time you strike an enemy with this weapon

table2data.name: Raptor Rapier
table2data.desc: A blade modelled after a raptors claw. Gives the blood debuff

table2data.name: Hornet Helmet
table2data.desc: A helmet modelled after some kind of harrowing hornet

table2data.name: Vapory Vestige
table2data.desc: A strange mask. Prevents stat drops

table2data.name: Philosopher's Stone
table2data.desc: Grants eternal life, or so legends say. Note: Required to beat the final boss, the Gig of Chad. Has no pratical use in gameplay and is only used a cutscene

table3data.name: Galvanic Spear
table3data.desc: 20 consective thunderous strikes. Piercing enemies and chain lighting for every strike

table3data.name: Scorch Kartana
table3data.desc: Control the weight of the arrows and how far they carry. Can shoot 5 arrows at a time, making them heavy or light and able to control the speed in which the arrows fly

table3data.name: Gravity Long Bow
table3data.desc: Control the weight of the arrows and how far they carry. Can shoot 5 arrows at a time, making them heavy or light and able to control the speed in which the arrows fly

table3data.name: Ripple Rapier
table3data.desc: Blade is made of high pressure water, making you able to control the length and being able to cut around any tight corners. A flexible blade of water that can cut enemies, even through cracks of walls

table3data.name: Blood Sickles
table3data.desc: Able to teleport through blood portals, making movement unpredicable. Able to throw them and grapple opponents along with doing long ranged slices through the air
